expectations.text: Explains the character ROM appears at $D000-$DFFF when CHAREN (bit 2 of $01) is cleared
expectations.evidence: 'Char ROM only appears when CHAREN = bit 2 of $01 = 0. Shares $D000-$DFFF with I/O.'

expectations.text: Sets $01 to $33 (or otherwise clears bit 2) to expose char ROM, then restores it (e.g. $37)
expectations.evidence: 'Clear bit 2 → $33 (%00110011)'; asm AND #%11111011 then PLA/STA $01; default $37 stated

expectations.text: Disables interrupts (SEI) during the copy because the I/O area is banked out
expectations.evidence: 'SEI before, CLI after' with 'CIA1 gone from $D000-$DFFF' reasoning

expectations.text: Copies 4096 bytes (2 char sets) or 2048 per set to $3000
expectations.evidence: 'LDX #$10 ; 16 pages = 4096 bytes (both char sets)' to $3000; also LDX #$08 for 2K
